description: The girls' birthdays: all of SERIFU/G_BIRTH.BIN (base 0x801B0000; game-internals 6s), 582 strings, plus in-place words in the overlays: the 93 gift names that {A} inserts (99 x 33-byte records, 'slot': 33), identical in DATE, DATE2, GEKO, KANGEI, SHOUGATU and SHUGAKU.EXN, all six translated with the same English as the gift options; and GEKO.EXN's location banners and 'Ring, ring...' lines. Thirteen sections (GEKO fill 0x80134D10): one per girl (girl ids 0-10 -> sections 1,5,2,3,10,6,8,4,0,9,12), 7 an unused copy of Nozomi's, 11 the gift lists (part 3*girl + year - 1995; Megumi's and Yumi's 1995 slots are the original's empty placeholders). Each girl: give or skip, the gift choice, a greeting by rank, her reaction (loved / fine / disliked) and the player's thought; Shiori, Yuina and Nozomi also have the holiday version (calling her out, the phone answers by rank, the meeting). Verified in DuckStation (force_birthday.py --her/--as, hidden emulator; docs/testing.md "The girls' birthdays"): Shiori's school-day birthday and her holiday phone version in full; every other girl's section via the girl swap (her gift list, greeting, thanks and reaction; the label shows Shiori in that forcing). Not seen: the other ranks' greetings and reactions, Yuina's and Nozomi's phone versions, the 1996/97 gift lists, natural triggers.
